subject: Rhea Singh — full-day virtual onsite: parallel panels & debrief plan
messages:
From: Eddie Clarke <eddie@hirefast.co>

Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Rhea Singh — proposed virtual onsite (candidate in IST)

Hi Laura,

Quick intro — Rhea Singh (attached resume) is a strong candidate for the Staff Infrastructure Engineer role. She is currently in India (IST) and has signaled flexibility on a few mornings (09:00–13:00 IST) next week. HireFast did a phone screen: strong systems design and infra ownership.

To reduce churn for the candidate we recommend a compressed full-day virtual onsite using parallel panels where feasible: two simultaneous 30-min panels (deep panels after) and one longer system design slot. Proposed structure below — can you confirm panel owners and scribe volunteers?

Proposal (candidate local times in parentheses):
- 30 min: Onsite kickoff / culture (9:30 IST / 22:00 PDT previous day) — interviewer A
- Two parallel 30-min panels (systems, infra ownership) (10:15 IST / 22:45 PDT)
- 45 min: Deep system design (11:15 IST / 23:45 PDT)
- 30 min: Team sync + candidate Q&A (12:30 IST / 00:30 PDT)

Attachments: Rhea_Singh_Resume.pdf, interview-eval-template.docx

Let me know if this sequencing works for your team and who can take the panels/scribes.

Regards,
Eddie
Eddie Clarke | Recruiter, HireFast

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Eddie Clarke <eddie@hirefast.co>, Rhea Singh <rhea.singh@example.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Rhea Singh — proposed virtual onsite (candidate in IST)

Thanks Eddie — and hi Rhea, excited to move forward. A few notes/constraints from our side:

- We can do a compressed virtual onsite, but prefer the day-of order to start with a 20-min kickoff (introductions + logistics), then two parallel 35-min panels, a 50-min design deep dive, and finish with a 25-min hiring manager conversation + candidate Q&A.
- Timezones: candidate 09:30 IST is 22:00 PDT (previous day) — that late window is fine for us if the candidate prefers mornings. Please confirm Rhea's preference for an early IST start vs slightly later.
- Panel owners (proposed):
  - Systems / Reliability panel: neha_kapoor
  - Infra ownership / platform panel: karthik_iyer (I can host the kickoff and handle HM convo)
  - Culture / cross-functional: jonas_weber

Scribe volunteers: please confirm — ideally the scribe is not an interviewer in the same panel.

I've sketched a candidate-friendly schedule (PDT times shown). Please review and I'll send calendar invites once confirmed.

Draft (PDT times):
- 22:00–22:20 PDT (20m) — Kickoff & logistics (Laura)
- 22:25–23:00 PDT (35m) — Panel A (Neha)
- 22:25–23:00 PDT (35m) — Panel B (Karthik) [parallel]
- 23:10–00:00 PDT (50m) — System design deep dive (Neha + Karthik)
- 00:10–00:35 PDT (25m) — Hiring manager + Q&A (Laura)

Related doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-interview-plans — see the slot matrix and scribe checklist.

If that works, Eddie can confirm with Rhea and we can lock calendar slots.

- Laura

Laura / Neha — happy to take Panel B (platform/ownership). I can also co-lead the design deep dive. A couple of asks:

1) Can we assign a dedicated scribe who is not interviewing in the same panel? I nominate Jonas as scribe for Panel A if he's okay; otherwise I'll bring someone from my team.
2) If both panels flag a quality regression (score < threshold), what's the escalation? Do we route to hiring manager skip-level or schedule a follow-up technical deep dive? Need a one-line fallback in the invite.

Short answer: yes to scribe separation; fallback is a 30-min follow-up with senior engineering (skip-level) within 48 hours. I'll draft fallback language for the invites.

— Karthik
